Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q02.3
Accountable role (person unassigned): Independent reviewer and representative users
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Qualify the full pilot workflow for accessibility, including the existing open console gate.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: Q02 (bd-01M4W40M3Y7795AWYWHVAA9K68)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Run the existing CON-03 scenarios and new login/directory/task/intake/export screens with actual supported screen-reader/browser combinations and keyboard-only navigation.
2. Record focus order, announcements, error recovery, tables/dialogs and narrow-layout behavior; distinguish unsupported or not-run combinations from passes.
3. Fix blocking issues and retain human retest evidence; automated axe/browser checks cannot substitute for actual assistive-technology use.

Verification: Tester/date/OS/browser/screen-reader versions, source-bound task matrix and resolved findings; update console adoption only when its gates pass.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/Q02.3/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Human assistive-technology tester

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/evidence/console/adoption.json
- docs/http-api.md

Blocked by:
- W02: bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW
- F05: bd-01M4W40JSS0HZY131BNTKV1QF3

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
